controlledNativeRead.finding: The old fill returned empty with no input event while inert. The actual committed draft then contained empty notes, the intended Date and the exact photo hash. Native required-notes validation prevented Review while failStore remained empty. Readiness produced the intended notes and visible Review; the same final queue-quota failure preserved the committed draft and truthful recovery guidance.
controlledNativeRead.scope: No application Review or storage-warning change is justified by this experiment; pending save or restoration loss did not explain the controlled failure.

permanentNativeRegression.location: Existing queue-quota case; browser group count remains 38
permanentNativeRegression.contract: Run the actual shared selection helper while native draft completion delivery is held. It must remain pending until explicit release; then enter and assert exact notes/Date in both DOM and committed draft before any storage-warning test begins.

oldSemanticsRed.assertion: Storage fixture selection must wait for native draft restoration
oldSemanticsRed.sourceStage: The hold and setup assertions with a raw-selection substitute, recorded before explicit 10s options were added to calls of the new helper; the raw-selection substitute does not use readiness options.

permanentNativeRegression.limit: An unusually slow raw selection could exceed the 100ms negative observation window; the captured old execution fails this assertion and the native result is held until explicit release.

fix.setup: Initial normal selection uses the shared prior-surface/selected-value/non-inert helper, then asserts exact entered notes/Date and their committed draft values.
fix.pausedClock: After same-account sign-in, the intentional manual evaluate/change action is retained through the helper callback. Node-side polling binds the replacement surface and non-inert state without advancing the paused application clock; exact new notes are asserted before continuing.
fix.preservedAdversarialSelection: Template/clear changes during held estimate/dialog remain raw: they intentionally test cancellation and perform no subsequent edit.
fix.timeouts: Existing Review waits, storage polling and new storage selection-readiness limits remain 10000ms; no deadline inflation.
fix.storageBehavior: Quota faults, before/after draft equality, no automatic cleanup, no unexpected uploads/posts, exact original evidence and recovery-warning assertions are retained.

validation.environment: Local Windows, Node24.15.0 and locked Playwright1.61.1; real application modules, native IndexedDB and Blob persistence with all HTTP/browser-boundary interactions isolated
validation.independentReview: Product reviewer found no blocker in the controls, exact content assertions, preserved cancellation stress or paused-clock readiness; backend reviewer independently classified the normal versus adversarial selections.
